mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which stimulates economic growth and increases S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive when UNRATE exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth coupled with rising unemployment indicates a late-cycle expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite strong GDP and rising unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid increase in housing starts during early-cycle expansion signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur with rapid housing starts in early-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production indicates strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative with rising industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: Decline in retail sales signals weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur with retail sales below 500000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate alongside increasing unemployment indicates tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur with rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing employment growth in late-cycle expansion signals a downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur with slowing employment in late-cycle.
